name: eMemory Technology Inc.
summary: eMemory Technology Inc. engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of embedded flash memory in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers security products, such as NeoPUF, a hardware security technology; PUFrt, which delivers a secure hardware root of trust; PUFcc, a crypto coprocessor integrating key generation, storage, and encryption; PUFhsm, an embedded hardware security module; and PUFPQC for post-quantum security. It also provides PUF flash series, including SoC, protecting embedded, NAND, and NOR Flash; NeoBit, a programmable logic device; NeoFuse, an anti-fuse solution; NeoEE, a single-poly embedded memory device; NeoMTP, a single-poly embedded memory device;…
